mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strong economic growth, leads to increased consumer spending, driving up S&P 500 prices over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 3.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5%, indicating a tight labor market, S&P 500 prices tend to rise over the next 60 trading days as companies invest in growth initiatives.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window during low UNRATE periods.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing HOUST (new housing starts) and RSAFS (retail sales) signals a consumption-driven economic upswing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances with triggered HOUST-RSAFS interaction.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.5% monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating strong industrial production growth, drives up S&P 500 prices over the next 5 trading days as supply chains adapt to increased demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window following INDPRO growth surges.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (< 3.5%) and rising CPIAUCSL (> 2% YoY) signals a potential inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 55% of instances with triggered FEDFUNDS-CPIAUCSL interaction.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth tends to positively correlate with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as a strong labor market supports economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward return correlation with PAYEMS growth falls below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery regimes, a 5% increase in RSAFS signals a consumption-driven rebound, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window during post-shock RSAFS growth surges.
